# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.js` is Project Nayuki's QR Code generator library, compiled from TypeScript.
Retrieved 2026-09-26 from <https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js>.
Trailing spaces were removed; the complete MIT license is preserved at the top of the file. No CDN or network request is used at runtime.

Project documentation: <https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library>
